legacy_projection.route_title: Relaxed Bounds Grid-Search for TiO2/SiO2 AR Coating
legacy_projection.compilation_rationale: The user requests a deterministic grid search (8x8=64 evaluations) with no iterative refinement. The supported TMM task draft supports gradient-based optimization (Adam/LBFGS) or forward simulation, but does not support discrete exhaustive grid search as an optimizer method. This requires a higher-fidelity execution engine capable of discrete combinatorial sampling.
